passage.label: Are you more difficult creation or heaven Allah constructed it; raised ceiling proportioned it; darkened night extracted brightness; after spread earth; extracted water pasture; mountains set firmly; provision you grazing livestock

arabicExcerpts.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا

mainSubject.label: Man questioned whether he is a more difficult creation than the heaven that Allah constructed, raising its ceiling and proportioning it, darkening its night and extracting its brightness, then spreading the earth and extracting its water and pasture, setting mountains firmly as provision for humanity and grazing livestock

subordinateSubjects.label: Man questioned: are you more difficult to create than the heaven
Allah constructed it and raised its ceiling and proportioned it
Darkened its night and extracted its brightness
After that He spread the earth
Extracted from it its water and its pasture
As provision for you and your grazing livestock

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Human creation compared to heaven-construction as proof of resurrection power

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Water, pasture and firmly-set mountains provided for humanity and livestock

relationships.label: Heaven constructed, ceiling raised, proportioned, night darkened and brightness extracted
Earth spread after heaven with water and pasture extracted from it

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the sudden-alertness-after-one-shout statement (14) before the Musa narrative opens (15); P2 ends with the warning-for-the-God-fearing conclusion (26) before the creation-comparison argument begins (27); P3 runs through the heaven-earth-mountain provision catalogue (27-33); P4 covers the Overwhelming Calamity, the two-refuge outcomes, the Hour-timing question and the closing time-compression simile (34-46).
